token_family_info.$value: State-based color mapping for interaction elements. Interactive state colors for components. Both Lightness (Light/Dark) and Emphasis (High/Low) modes affect resolved values across all 4 columns. Do: Reference when authoring compiled interaction tokens that require emphasis resolution. Avoid: Do not assign directly to component tokens — use compiled S-tier tokens instead.

Reduced-saturation emphasis for interactive elements in passive layout zones — headers, footers, and sidebars where actions should not draw attention away from primary content. Colors appear near-neutral while remaining interactive. Exposes contrast_levels (raw contrast steps for custom compositions). Do: Use for navigation links, header and footer actions, and any interactive element in a zone where monochromatic appearance is preferred over a visible call-to-action color. Avoid: Do not use as the default for primary form actions or submission buttons — those require High emphasis to communicate their role clearly.

Raw contrast-level colors for emphasis-low interaction — near-neutral appearance. Provides fg, bg, and border at three contrast steps without state semantics. Use: Custom interaction compositions in passive layout zones requiring direct contrast control, such as link states. Avoid: Composing a new named state that duplicates an existing component's own state tokens.
